about: Residue of the P0-M-2 port check (tests/db/test_port_check.py): each difference of the generated MetaData plus overlay from D3's DDL (d3_ddl.sql), keyed as the comparator names it, with its reason. Every item is by design; the BM25 kind list, the residue of probe Q-3, now matches D3.

residue.ops.run only generated unique ('id', 'sc: The target of the schema-version tie FKs from kb.entity and kb.claim (P0-M-2 decision); D3 §4 does not list it yet.
residue.kb.segment only generated check parse_re: An empty or whitespace-only parse reason is no reason (P0-M-2 decision, coordinator): KbSegment.parse_reason declares pattern '\S', which the generated validator kb_segment also applies; D3 §5 does not list it yet.
residue.kb.embedding column vec type: The model's HalfVec type has no dimension: it is the EmbeddingSpec's, fixed by S7 (OPEN-D3-2); D3's halfvec(1024) is one of the two candidates.
residue.kb.embedding index embedding_hnsw_alias: kb.embedding is created by the phase 1 migration that adds M04, not 0001 (D3 §5); its HNSW indexes need the halfvec dimension, which waits on S7 (OPEN-D3-2), so the overlay does not declare them yet.
residue.kb.embedding index embedding_hnsw_entity: kb.embedding is created by the phase 1 migration that adds M04, not 0001 (D3 §5); its HNSW indexes need the halfvec dimension, which waits on S7 (OPEN-D3-2), so the overlay does not declare them yet.

residue.kb.entity only generated foreign key ('s: The schema-version tie (P0-M-2 decision): the row's run FK is the composite (schema_version_id, run_id) -> ops.run (schema_version_id, id), declared ci:same: schema_version on the run slot, so the row's schema version is its run's (INV-03 then holds through the version-scoped FKs). It keeps the run slot's ON DELETE CASCADE.
residue.kb.entity only reference foreign key ('r: Replaced by the composite tie FK (same columns plus schema_version_id, same ON DELETE CASCADE).
residue.kb.entity only reference foreign key ('s: Implied by the tie: a NOT NULL composite FK sharing schema_version_id with ops.run already makes the column a valid schema version, so the compiler emits no FK of its own (one probe fewer per row on COPY).
residue.kb.entity index entity_kind: Supporting index of a composite FK that no key or index starts with (coordinator decision 18; probe Q-4, p0q.fk-cost: without one, deleting a run's entities took 9.3 s, with it 32 ms); D3 §5 does not list it yet. FK (schema_version_id, kind) -> meta.statement_kind; partial, as kind is null for non-statements.

FK (run_id, resolved_to_id) -> kb.entity (run_id, id), the self-reference that run deletion checks per entity; partial.
